an10.98:1.1: dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati. phāsuyeva viharati.
an10.98:1.6: diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdho. ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso
an10.98:1.8: dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudācāro, abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmujjo,
an10.98:1.10: pāsādiko hoti abhikkante paṭikkante. susaṃvuto antaragharepi nisajjāya,
an10.98:1.11: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an10.98:1.12: āsavānañca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an10.98:1.13: imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati phāsuyeva viharatīti.
